title: Decoding a stored script tolerates a missing id, symbol and worktree flag but requires name and command

title: Adding a project imports its scripts from droppy-code.json at the project root
source_evidence: DroppyCode/App/AppModel.swift:515-523 addProject(at:) - an existing project with the same standardized path is returned unchanged; otherwise a new Project is made and project.scripts = ProjectFile.scripts(at: url) before it is appended and a save is scheduled

DroppyCode/App/AppModel.swift:1330-1345 ProjectFile.scripts(at:) - reads Data from url.appendingPathComponent("droppy-code.json"), parses it as JSON, takes json["scripts"] as an array, and for each entry requires a string "name" and a string "command", mapping "icon" through symbol(for:) and reading "runOnWorktreeCreate" as a bool defaulting to false
preconditions: A folder is being added as a project for the first time.
action: The folder is added.
expected_result: If droppy-code.json exists at the project root and parses, every entry of its scripts array that has both a string name and a string command becomes a ProjectScript; entries missing either are silently skipped. The file's "icon" string is mapped to an SF Symbol name (PR-TERM-061) and "runOnWorktreeCreate" is read as a bool, defaulting to false. A missing, unreadable or unparseable file yields an empty list with no message. This import happens only when the project is first added: re-adding the same path returns the existing project and does NOT re-read the file, and nothing re-reads it later.
side_effects: One file read; the library save is scheduled.
persistence: The imported scripts become part of the persisted project record, so later edits in the editor diverge from the file and are not written back to it.
failure_cases: File absent, unreadable or invalid JSON: empty list, no error shown.
An entry without a name or without a command: that entry is skipped silently.
windows_path: Same file name at the project root and the same tolerant parse. The file name "droppy-code.json" is a project-level contract that users write by hand; whether the rename changes it is an owner decision, not a porting choice.
verification_method: contract fixture with a droppy-code.json holding valid, partial and malformed entries
